finalText:
Only `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` still uses `db.query` — left it alone since the file header says it's vendored, replaced wholesale on upgrade, don't edit.

10 package files (30 call sites) migrated to `db.execute({ sql, params })`: macroAdmin, sla, couponService, apiKeyAdmin, teamService, supplier, cohort, returnService, session, shipment, refund, variantAdmin.

Next: if you want the vendor adapter handled too, it'll need a different approach since it's overwritten on every upgrade — worth flagging to whoever owns the legacy-orm upgrade instead of a direct edit here.
